metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting a fly and somehow popped a dude?! Valorant aim’s drunk again
metadata.description:
Me: panic-clicking like I lost my brain
Enemy: probably rethinking every life choice
How did that even land? No idea, but I’m cashing in
Click if your aim ever ghosts you but still lands the kill!

Tap if your panic aim ever surprises even YOU!
